built_in_unique_allocation_plan.retail_placeholder_boundary: Only 24 jersey assets exist for 40 on-disc team slots. Making all 24 built-ins mutually unique assigns asset 12 to one built-in while the 16 online/user placeholders still select asset 12. Full 40-slot isolation is impossible without adding catalog capacity or changing the executable/filename ownership model.

nfl2k5.identity_warning: Equal decoded hashes are content aliases relevant to emulator texture replacement; they are not evidence of shared on-disc bytes.

physical_storage.result: Every audited torso, pants, sleeve, helmet00, and helmet02 selector resource occupies its own fixed, non-overlapping XISO span.

practical_fix.fit_gate: The rebuilt compressed stream must fit that selector's exact retail allocation; writers refuse overflow without producing an output.
practical_fix.hash_swap_caveat: A replacement system keyed only by decoded texture hash will still replace every equal-content owner until one owner is changed on disc.
practical_fix.method: Import artwork into the selected selector's existing resource span; do not duplicate an outer entry or patch a pointer.
practical_fix.status: available for the audited fixed-span writer families
